title: Add a warning or an error if the specified env file is missing
body:
When the following command is used
`leet kb add-local -e .env.ollama -k FTM -l info -p FILE.pdf`
if the file `.env.ollama` is missing the tool continues to work switching to OPENAI default service.

At least a warning should be preferred.
author: markod0925

comments.body:
Good point. Yes, currently if the env file fails to load, the program will use the default values to continue, which is not ideal. 

If the user specifies .env file, the intention is clear and the program should break if the .env file is not valid.

title: LLM API Provider Switching
body: Enable flexible switching between OpenAI and DeepSeek APIs to optimize for cost and effectiveness in different scenarios.
author: wlfnorman

comments.body: This is added in #35, now you can switch the providers by specifying a new .env file.

title: Web Content Integration
body: Implement functionality to **quickly** add single or multiple web pages to the knowledge base efficiently.
author: wlfnorman

comments.body: This would be a great addition.
Yes, we should be able to support this operation.

We can now use 

leet kb add-url -k <kb_name> -r <url>

and 

leet kb add-url-list -k <kb_name> -f <url_list_file>

to add urls to the knowledge base.

title: Enhanced Export Functionality
body:
Expand output capabilities to include auxiliary files in the export folder:

- Primary markdown documentation
- CSV data exports for extract flows
- Word cloud visualizations for opinion flows

All outputs saved in a designated folder
author: wlfnorman

comments.body:
We can use the  extract_output_format flow option to specify the output of the extract flow:

```
leet flow -t extract --info
        extract_output_format:
                      The output of the extracted data. Default is json. Currently also support 
                      csv, md. [FLOW: extract]
```

title: Markdown Export Parameter
body: Add parameter option to save output as markdown files for easier editing and sharing.
author: wlfnorman

comments.body:
By default the flow outputs are in markdown file and we can use -o option to specify an output file.

-o, --output-file FILE          Path to a file to save the output. Print to stdout if not specified.

title: Local Folder Q&A with References
body: Enable Q&A functionality based on local folder contents with source references.
author: wlfnorman
